name: Marina Saltwick
greetings: Patience, love. The fish can smell hurry.
Bring me Tidescales and I'll fit you out proper.
Pull up something with teeth? That's a sea creature. Hit it before it hits you.
Bait helps. Worms for speed, glowworms for the curious ones down deep.
Thirty years on these waters, and I still haven't seen what drops those Leviathan Scales.
